Privacy

Updated 1 October 2026

This website

This site does not ask you to create an account, use advertising trackers, or store analytics cookies. The Join button only copies bloxbob.net to your clipboard. The website host may process standard request data such as IP address and browser details to serve the page and keep it secure.

Playing on the server

When you connect, the Minecraft server processes your username, UUID, connection details and gameplay records needed for features such as homes, economy, teams, relics, moderation and settings. Staff can access records needed to operate and moderate the server.

Purchases

Ranks and crate keys are paid through Tebex, which handles checkout, payment and receipts as the merchant of record and shows its own privacy terms before payment. To deliver a purchase, this site sends the Minecraft username you enter and the package you chose to Tebex, and remembers that username in your browser so you don't have to type it again. We never see or store card details.

Questions

Contact BloxBob SMP staff in game if you need help with your data or account.
